Jobber vs Housecall Pro (2026)

Both run quotes, scheduling, dispatch and invoicing for home-service crews, and both publish their prices. The differences that matter are how they charge for users, what their AI receptionists cost, and which plan you need before QuickBooks and Zapier work.

← All comparisons · Facts checked Oct 15, 2026 on vendor pages
JobberHousecall Pro
Entry priceCore $29/mo billed annually ($49 monthly), 1 userBasic $59/mo annually ($79 monthly), 1 user
Next tiersConnect $99 ($139), Grow $149 ($199), 1 user each; extra users $29/moEssentials $149 ($189), 5 users; MAX from $299 ($329), 8 users
AI call answeringReceptionist: $29/mo for 30 conversations, $0.79 each after; included on PlusCSR AI: paid add-on, price not published
Estimate / quote follow-upAutomatic quote follow-ups (up to 2) on Connect and upPipeline automations (1st, 2nd, 3rd follow-up); added through a demo
QuickBooks OnlineSync on Connect and upIntegration on Essentials or MAX
ZapierConnect, Grow and PlusEssentials and MAX; one action (Create Customer)

"Not confirmed" means we couldn't find it on the vendor's own site. It may still exist, so ask them.

🧭 Which one should you pick?

  • 1 or 2 people, watching every dollar→ Jobber Core, at $29/mo billed annually.
  • 3 to 5 people in the field→ Run the numbers. Jobber Connect with 2 extra users is $157/mo billed annually, and Housecall Pro Essentials with 5 users is $149.
  • You do your books in QuickBooks Online→ Jobber Connect ($99/mo annually) is the cheapest plan on either side with QBO sync. Housecall Pro needs Essentials ($149).
  • You want an AI receptionist with a known price→ Jobber, since Receptionist pricing is published. Housecall Pro's CSR AI is quote-only.
  • You want to automate with Zapier→ Jobber. Its Zapier app can create clients, requests, quotes and jobs. Housecall Pro's can only create customers.

Questions people ask

Is Jobber cheaper than Housecall Pro?For one user, yes: $29/mo vs $59/mo billed annually. With five users it's close. Jobber Grow plus four extra users is $265/mo, and Housecall Pro Essentials is $149/mo.
Which works with QuickBooks Online?Both. Jobber syncs on Connect and up, Housecall Pro on Essentials or MAX.
Do they have AI receptionists?Yes. Jobber Receptionist is $29/mo for 30 conversations. Housecall Pro CSR AI is a paid add-on without a published price.
Do both have free trials?Jobber lists a free trial. Housecall Pro's pricing page lists a 14-day free trial.
